unavailable_or_unclassified: Generic recognition requires nondegenerate rank-two decompositions,invertible factor matrices/nonzero edge entries and exact supported field arithmetic. This is not a recognizer for arbitrary circuits/tensor networks. General boundary complexity charges the ACTUAL number of exposed faces and coefficient/field costs; planar embedding/cyclic order is supplied and checked. Original weights must be nonnegative with supported conditioning/positive totalmass; negative internal components are not probabilities. Rational/common-real-quadratic implementations do not silently handle arbitrary composita. The parent’s matched bucket-elimination implementation won tested instances; its earlier comparator was explicitly unavailable,so this is a parent comparison,not an independent review. No practical advantage or established novelty is claimed; P3remains visible-only.
